name: SS Manchuria
builder: New York Shipbuilding Company, Camden, New Jersey
summary: A large American-built passenger and cargo liner launched in 1903 for the Pacific Mail Steamship Company’s transpacific service, built by New York Shipbuilding at Camden, New Jersey; She and her sister Mongolia belonged to an ambitious generation of American liners intended for the San Francisco–Honolulu–Yokohama–Hong Kong–Manila trade.
